items.title: Neuro drives national retail wins with ChatGPT Business
items.summary: Neuro uses ChatGPT Business to scale nationwide with fewer than 70 employees, saving time, reducing costs, and turning faster execution across sales and operations into growth.

items.title: Fighting the New York Times’ invasion of user privacy
items.summary: OpenAI is fighting the New York Times’ demand for 20 million private ChatGPT conversations and accelerating new security and privacy protections to protect your data.

items.title: GPT-5.1 Instant and GPT-5.1 Thinking System Card Addendum
items.summary: This GPT-5 system card addendum provides updated safety metrics for GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking, including new evaluations for mental health and emotional reliance.

items.title: GPT-5.1: A smarter, more conversational ChatGPT
items.summary: We’re upgrading the GPT-5 series with warmer, more capable models and new ways to customize ChatGPT’s tone and style. GPT-5.1 starts rolling out today to paid users.
